extracted.name: Black bean & spicy beef pasta
extracted.description: Use our beef and lentil ragu recipe as the base to make this quick and easy pasta. If cooking for youngsters, you can leave out the chipotle paste
ingredient_lines: 400g can black beans drained and rinsed
3 roasted red peppers from a jar drained and finely chopped
instruction_lines: Cook the pasta for 2 mins less than the pack instructions, then drain and set aside. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat and cook the spring onions and garlic for 2-3 mins until fragrant.

Tip in the black beans, red peppers, sweetcorn, taco seasoning and chipotle paste, if using. Fry for 2 mins, mixing well before stirring in the leftover ragu and a splash of water. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5-7 mins until the sauce is piping hot. Stir in the double cream and cooked pasta, and season to taste. Serve with the cheese and parsley scattered over.
